color-contrast (light).note: Measured 2026-08-19 with the clock pinned to 2026-08-12, the same instant `check:state-a11y` uses — before that this gate read a live `new Date()` and its counts drifted with the calendar demos, which meant the allowance had to be set to the loosest day and hid a real regression behind the slack on every other one. The four routes are /guides/tokens/colors, /reference/components/calendar, /reference/components/event-calendar and /reference/components/slider. Three causes. (1) WCAG-exempt inactive controls axe cannot recognise, because `disabled` sits on a custom element: `<wr-btn disabled>` labels and the disabled switch / checkbox labels (those use `--wr-color-on-surface-muted` correctly; it just happens to equal the `medium` intent in the dark theme). (2) `wr-calendar__day--out-of-month` at 2.23:1 — ENABLED buttons reachable with the arrow keys, so the exemption never applied; the colour is fine (#5f6c7d, 4.63:1 on white) and `opacity: 0.55` is what drops it, and `state-a11y-baseline.json` records why tuning that number cannot fix it. (3) The swatch grid on /guides/tokens/colors, which labels every shade of a ramp with `{intent}-contrast`, a token calibrated for the base shade only. `wr-squircle--bordered` came OFF this list and its explanation with it — the ::before artefact where axe compared the intent against itself; /reference/components/squircle now measures clean in both themes.

color-contrast (dark).note: The same causes as the light entry, on the two pages where the dark theme also lands under 4.5: /guides/tokens/colors and /reference/components/calendar.

target-size (light).note: One route: /reference/components/carousel. `wr-carousel`'s pagination dots are 8x8 CSS px with centres 14px apart (the active dot is 20x8). WCAG 2.5.8 wants 24x24 targets, or undersized ones whose 24px circles do not intersect; 14px centres fail both, and the spacing exception cannot rescue them. The `touch-target` mixin does not help either — it is gated on `@media (pointer: coarse)`, and 2.5.8 applies to every pointer. `wr-event-calendar`'s 20px chips used to be the second route and are not, at the pinned date, on the page at rest — but they have NOT been fixed: `check:state-a11y` still measures them inside the month state and holds them in its own baseline. Do not read this entry as the chips having been raised.

WCAG 2.5.8 wants 24x24 targets, or undersized ones whose 24px circles do not intersect; 14px centres fail both, and the spacing exception cannot rescue them. The `touch-target` mixin does not help either — it is gated on `@media (pointer: coarse)`, and 2.5.8 applies to every pointer. `wr-event-calendar`'s 20px chips used to be the second route and are not, at the pinned date, on the page at rest — but they have NOT been fixed: `check:state-a11y` still measures them inside the month state and holds them in its own baseline.
